ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Allcargo Logistics Limited announced a significant, planned leadership transition, with current MD & CEO Mr. Ketan Kulkarni resigning effective December 31, 2026, to assume a new Chief Growth Officer role within the broader Allcargo Group. Mr. Vijay Nehra, an experienced leader in transformation and supply chain, will join as Chief Transformation Officer & MD Designate on October 1, 2026, before taking over as MD & CEO on January 1, 2027, pending shareholder approval. This strategic move signals continuity within the group and a renewed focus on transformation and future growth, with no apparent red flags regarding the outgoing CEO's departure or the incoming leader's qualifications.
